description: Na₃MnS₂(O₄F)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.85 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to two equivalent O and four equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₂F₄ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MnO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₂F₄ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.38 Å. There are two shorter (2.41 Å) and two longer (2.53 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Mn is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form MnO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₂F₄ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₂F₄ pentagonal pyramid. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and two longer (2.21 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. Both Mn-F bond lengths are 1.92 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₂F₄ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.53 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one S atom. F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Mn tetrahedra.
